user_questions.question: What counts as 'a competitor listed' for Opportunities over $50k entering Negotiation/Review? Options: (A) the existing text field Opportunity.MainCompetitors__c ('Main Competitor(s)', Text(100), editable on all 4 Opportunity layouts) is not blank; (B) at least one OpportunityCompetitor record on the Competitors related list (on Opportunity Layout, 0 records today); (C) either one. Evidence: both exist and are on the layout; no automation uses either. Recommendation: A (a single declarative validation rule; B needs a flow or Apex because validation rules cannot count child records).
user_questions.simulated_answer: A: validation rule when Amount > 50000 and Stage = Negotiation/Review makes Main Competitors required.

skill_friction: Workflow step 5 says to ask after D1 and step 3, but the I call is where the fork naturally shows up too; here D1 already surfaced it, so no friction in ordering, but SKILL.md does not say whether D2 should be sent before or after the question (sent before).

The 'four wrong AskCoworker claims -> may skip R and T' rule: unclear whether a wrong design proposal (unneeded permission set based on 'profile FLS unknown') counts as one claim or two (fact + proposal); counted as one.

Some AskCoworker errors (e.g. 'LWC is not SOQL-queryable') concern topics the design does not need; SKILL.md says to drop facts the design does not need but still count wrong claims, so it is unclear whether an irrelevant wrong claim should count toward the threshold.

Validation-rule-only specs: spec-format says declarative-only changes get manual checks, but the RUNNER/skill gives no guidance on whether a validation rule needs a layout/help text update when its error location field is already placed; decided none.

Org currency code cannot be read in a single-currency org with the allowed commands (Organization.DefaultCurrencyIsoCode unavailable, User has no DefaultCurrencyIsoCode); org-verification.md mentions currency describe but Opportunity.Amount describe does not expose the code. Recorded as an assumption.
